name: Deck bridge
description: Lets Stream Deck and other programs on this computer press keys that profiles bind, over HTTP on 127.0.0.1.

services.name: tap
services.title: Tap a deck key
services.description: Presses a key of the input source deck and lets it go after ms milliseconds (80 by default). The calling extension needs the permission hardware too, since a call runs with the permissions both extensions have.

services.name: status
services.title: Bridge status
services.description: Whether the bridge listens, on which port, and which deck keys are held.

permissions.name: network.listen
permissions.reason: Stream Deck and other programs on this computer call it on 127.0.0.1.

permissions.name: hardware
permissions.reason: The keys it receives reach the key mapping as the input source deck.

zh_CN.name: 按键桥
zh_CN.description: 让 Stream Deck 等本机程序经 127.0.0.1 上的 HTTP 按下方案里绑定的键。
zh_CN.panels.deck.title: 按键桥
zh_CN.services.tap.title: 按一下按键桥的键
zh_CN.services.tap.description: 按下输入源 deck 的一个键，ms 毫秒后松开（默认 80）。调用的扩展也要有 hardware 权限，因为服务按双方都有的权限运行。
zh_CN.services.status.title: 按键桥的状态
zh_CN.services.status.description: 是否在监听、用哪个端口，以及按住了哪些键。
